set.body:
Objective:
Add a leaf group-ntab adapter that prepares typed second-level inputs from Frame metadata and ntab features, then reconstructs group outputs with exact support and lineage.

Boundary:
- Frame grouping remains descriptive relational partitioning.
- ScalaFIM group remains inferential and owns GroupData, designs, estimators, contrasts, variance capability, and reference distributions.
- group-ntab depends on group and ntab. Neither lower module depends back on the bridge.
- Effects-only and effects-plus-variance inputs preserve the existing variance capability at the type level; the bridge does not erase it to Option.

Scope:
- Select one row per subject/contrast cell through typed Frame keys and explicit duplicate/missing policies.
- Resolve aligned effect and optional variance features through ntab.
- Prepare deterministic subject, contrast, sample, and support receipts.
- Construct explicit categorical/numeric second-level design inputs without treating an ordinary Frame groupBy key as an inferential term automatically.
- Reconstruct group vectors and maps using retained support evidence, not vector length.
- Attach all contributing root rows and derivation steps to result features.

Acceptance:
- EffectsOnly inputs cannot enter a variance-required group builder at compile time.
- Prepared effect and variance matrices share subject order, sample order, and exact support.
- Treatment coding and prepared results are invariant to source row order when references are explicit.
- Duplicate subject/contrast cells, missing effects, nonpositive variances, support mismatch, and design-rank failures are structured errors.
- Reconstruction and lineage contain all and only the selected contributors.
- JVM and Scala.js pass an effects-only and effects-plus-variance workflow through the bridge.
set.title: group-ntab: inferential bridge from Frame metadata and exact-support ntab features
